author: Codex primary
observations: GTK final review shows disk, method, five-second delay and disabled Erase now.
Tk owner checkbox, confirmation entry and keyboard entry are fully visible at their sampled sizes; all27 critical Tk matrix inputs also have independently measured visibility.

Long body content intentionally scrolls. The extra-large GTK owner capture shows the beginning of that scrollable content; this is not a claim that every paragraph or control is visible simultaneously.
result: No new visual defect found in the five retained captures; matrix and native regression tests provide the broader stated coverage.
